title: Pretzel Vanilla
description:
A client sided modpack containing
optimisation, quality of life, and tons of immerson.
body:
Featuring __optimisation__ and __performance__ mods like **Sodium**, **Cull Leaves**, **Entity Culling**, **Lithium** and more.

Quality of Life mods like **Cut Trough**, **Enhanced Tooltips**, [Mouse Tweaks](https://modrinth.com/mod/mouse-tweaks) and more.

Boat-load amount of immersion mods and resource packs to spice up the game,
a few visual examples are **Hold My Items**, **[Catified Cursor](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/catcursor)**, [Fresh Animations](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fresh-animations) and many more visual improvements.

But not just visual, also **audio**, for example [Sounds](https://modrinth.com/mod/sound), **Cool Rain**, **Sound Physics Remastered**, [Reactive Music](https://modrinth.com/mod/reactive-music) and more.

Additional included mods are:
1. [Completionist's Index](https://modrinth.com/mod/completionists-index)
2. [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)
3. [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons)
4. Iris (For shaders)
5. [Item Description](https://modrinth.com/mod/item-descriptions)
(Hold **Ctrl** while looking at items for info about that item)

But most important of all, a custom resource pack that changes the texture of bread to pretzel. (naturally, obviously, duh)

Enjoy
